0022600184.text: The San Antonio Spurs (5-2, on a five-game win streak and 3-2 at home) host the Dallas Mavericks (4-3, coming off a loss, and 2-2 on the road) in the Spurs' eighth game of the season, with San Antonio 6th in the West and Dallas 9th. The Spurs lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-106 win in Dallas on October 24, and they won the 2025-26 series 4-0. Spurs players Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out, while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Max Christie is day-to-day with a hip issue and is a game-time decision.
